independent_review_finding.finding: In all 12 cases, the aligned archived target's first-versus-second position in the archived option list matched the current preferred target's first-versus-second display position; the conflict target occupied the complementary position.
independent_review_finding.consequence: An aligned-minus-conflict current-selection contrast could not distinguish semantic alignment from reuse of the archived selected target's list position.
independent_review_finding.scope: This is a prospective design defect discovered after native token registration but before preflight, server launch, live token checks, or any model generation. It is not an empirical model result.

decision.remedy: Create a separately versioned prospective v2 design that crosses current preferred display position with aligned archived list position before any v2 tokenization or generation. Do not edit, overwrite, or reinterpret v1.
